items.title: China shifts cleanup focus to water at people's doorsteps

items.title: Heat waves more frequent and intense, last longer
items.description: Against the backdrop of global warming, the onset of land-based heat waves around the world has significantly advanced in the 21st century, with faster development into peak temperatures. The occurrence of such weather phenomena has become more frequent, intense and persistent since 1979, according to recently published research titled "Earlier and faster heat wave onset on land under a warming climate" in the international academic journal Nature Climate Change.
